Authentic and simulated project-based learning to improve students’ employability skills and their translator competence. However, none has been done to compare the impact of authentic and simulated projects on the improvement of students’ employability skills and translator sub-competences. Four research questions guided the study: (a) what PjBL procedure was adopted at the practicum course at the research setting, (b) were students’ perceived level of employability skills after the PjBL implementation significantly higher than before, (c) did the authentic project drive students’ perceived employability skills higher than the simulated project did, and (d) what translator sub-competences were mostly developed with authentic and simulated PjBL procedures. _et al._ Authentic and simulated project-based learning to improve students’ employability skills and their translator competence.

results.title: A systematic literature review on authentic assessment in higher ...
results.content: # A systematic literature review on authentic assessment in higher education: Best practices for the development of 21st century skills, and policy considerations. We conducted a systematic review on how authentic assessment can develop 21stcentury skills. Findings suggest authentic assessment enhances skills such as critical thinking, problem-solving, and collaboration. There is a growing role of technology in implementing authentic assessments, particularly in online education. This paper systematically reviews relevant literature from various disciplines in higher education, focusing on the development of 21st-century skills that can enhance students’ employability. The main objectives are to explore both reported effective implementation strategies of authentic assessment and the implications across different stakeholder groups-students, teaching staff, and policy makers. Findings indicate that authentic assessment enhances key employability skills; at the same time, challenges have been identified for its effective implementation, including resistance from some stakeholders and the need for adequate training and resources.
